prompt:
Locked-off camera, no zoom, no pan. Behind the glass at the wooden counter, the cashier in the blonde bob wig and navy balaclava with the white ring and the red triangle over his left eye (right of frame) faces the camera, his black-gloved hands on the small POSITION CLOSED sign on the counter ledge. He slides the sign the last few centimetres along the ledge, deliberately, lets go, and sits back in his chair, hands folding in front of him. On the right, the tall black server cabinet with its small screen reading DISCOUNT APPLIED stands close to the counter. Its fans visibly slow, their blades going from a blur to slowly turning, and its lights blink more slowly. Then it begins to roll backward on its castors, slowly and heavily, moving as one rigid upright box, sliding out of frame to the right until only the counter and the cashier remain, with the room behind the counter in view. The small sign reads POSITION CLOSED throughout, the screen reads DISCOUNT APPLIED while it is in view, and the carved sign above reads POWER. Same light throughout.
Natural documentary realism, soft overhead light.
Thanks.
